Fi vs Tractive GPS Dog Tracker (2026)

en.commentary: Tractive stays my default recommendation, and this month reinforces why. The April app update pushed health and activity data to the front screen, so you glance once and see steps, sleep and location together. Live updates land every two to three seconds in my walks, which is the number that matters when a dog slips a fence and you are chasing a moving dot. A rugged adventure version for large breeds is arriving this summer, and that tells me the roadmap is aimed at working dogs, not just city pets. Fi Series 3 keeps second on the strength of battery life alone. I regularly get six to eight weeks between charges, and the integrated collar means the tracker cannot pop off during rough play, which is a real advantage for chewers and escape artists. Cube holds third for owners who hate subscriptions, since the PRO model runs close to a year per charge and the monthly fee stays low. SpotOn and Garmin Alpha remain the picks for property fencing and serious hunting range, where their coverage numbers earn their premium. AirTag still earns a spot as the cheapest way to find a dog that stays inside Find My range, though it is a locator, not a health tracker. For most owners walking a dog in a normal neighborhood, Tractive gives the fastest peace of mind for the least money over three years, and that is the recommendation I stand behind.

highlights.body: Two to three second live updates and a health dashboard on the home screen make it the tracker I trust when a dog bolts.

zh-tw.commentary: Tractive 依然是我第一個推薦的選擇，這個月更讓我更有信心。四月的 App 改版把健康跟活動資料拉到首頁，一眼就能同時看到步數、睡眠跟定位，用起來很順手。我實際遛狗時，即時更新大概每兩到三秒跳一次，這個數字才是關鍵，狗一鑽出圍籬你在後面追那個移動的點時，就靠它。今年夏天還要出一款給大型犬的強化戶外版，看得出來它的產品規劃是瞄準工作犬，不只是都市寵物。Fi Series 3 穩坐第二，靠的就是續航。我常常六到八週才充一次電，而且項圈跟追蹤器一體成型，玩得再兇也不會鬆脫，對愛咬東西跟愛逃家的狗來說很實用。Cube 排第三，適合討厭綁月費的人，PRO 版一次充電幾乎撐一年，月費也壓得低。SpotOn 跟 Garmin Alpha 則是給要做電子圍籬跟認真打獵的人，它們的覆蓋範圍夠強，貴得有道理。AirTag 還是留了一席，是找室內走失狗最便宜的方式，它是定位器，健康功能就別期待了。對大多數在一般社區遛狗的人來說，Tractive 三年下來花最少的錢換到最快的安心感，這個推薦我站得住腳。

highlights.title: Tractive 穩坐第一
highlights.body: 每兩到三秒的即時更新加上首頁健康儀表板，狗一衝出去我最信得過它。

references.title: Fi vs Tractive GPS Dog Tracker (2026)
Tractive vs Fi Dog GPS Tracker 2026: Which One Actually Keeps Your Dog Safe?

en.commentary: The Tractive Dog 6 holds my number one, and its recent health-feature update is a big reason the lead feels safe. The app now leads with each pet's health and status at a glance, adds a visual activity timeline, and introduced advanced scratch monitoring that can flag skin allergies or stress worth raising with your vet. On top of that, its live tracking updates every 2 to 3 seconds with strong outdoor accuracy, and real-world testing has it stretching well past its rated battery life on a single charge. That combination of live accuracy, coverage, and now genuinely useful health data is what earns the top score. The Fi Series 3 stays my number two and remains the pick for anyone who wants a rugged full-collar replacement with battery life that runs for weeks between charges. If you want strong tracking without a monthly commitment, the Cube GPS Pro and the SpotOn GPS Fence both deliver, with SpotOn's virtual-fence approach still the standout for property containment. Serious hunters and working-dog handlers should stick with the Garmin Alpha 200i for its range, even though the subscription-free value sits lower. And the Apple AirTag remains the budget backstop, cheap and long-lasting, though it is a proximity finder rather than true live GPS. My advice stays the same: match the tracker to how your dog actually lives, then let subscription cost settle any tie.

zh-tw.commentary: Tractive Dog 6 守住我的第一，最近那次健康功能更新是我覺得它領先很穩的一大理由。App 現在一打開就先給你每隻寵物的健康與狀態總覽，加了視覺化的活動時間軸，還推出進階抓癢監測，能標記出值得跟獸醫提的皮膚過敏或壓力訊號。除此之外，它的即時定位每 2 到 3 秒更新一次，戶外精準度很紮實，實測下來單次充電還能撐得比標示續航久一大截。即時精準度、覆蓋範圍，再加上現在真的實用的健康數據，這套組合就是它拿最高分的原因。Fi Series 3 穩坐我的第二，還是那些想要一條耐操、可以整條換掉的項圈、又要續航能撐好幾週的人的首選。想要好定位又不想被月費綁住，Cube GPS Pro 跟 SpotOn GPS Fence 都辦得到，SpotOn 的虛擬圍籬在圈定活動範圍這塊依然是亮點。認真的獵人跟工作犬飼主就繼續選 Garmin Alpha 200i，看上它的傳輸距離，雖然免訂閱的性價比分數低一些。Apple AirTag 則還是預算的最後防線，便宜又耐用，不過它是靠近才找得到的定位器，不是真正的即時 GPS。我的建議一樣，照你家狗實際的生活方式挑追蹤器，同分時再讓訂閱費用來決勝。

en.commentary:
Tractive Dog 6 keeps my number one spot, and this week gave me another reason to feel good about it. Tractive has an extra-strong adventure version for large dogs arriving this summer alongside the existing XL model, which tells me the company is still putting money into the hardware side. The core reason I recommend it stays the same: live position updates land every two to three seconds when you open LIVE mode, and that refresh rate is the single number that decides whether you catch a loose dog in the next street or lose the trail entirely. Coverage across 175 countries on one subscription is the other half of the argument, and nothing else at this price matches it.

Fi Series 3 holds second, and the case for it is battery. Owners consistently report multi-week runtime, and the Series 3+ stretches to roughly three months of standby by switching intelligently between WiFi and cellular. If you live in the US and your dog is a home-and-neighbourhood dog rather than a wilderness dog, that means you charge it about as often as you change a smoke alarm battery. The integrated collar design matters too, because a tracker that cannot separate from the band is a tracker that is still on the dog when it counts.

I nudged Cube GPS Pro's value score up a tenth this week. Its pitch is the lowest total subscription cost paired with long runtime, and that combination keeps looking stronger the longer you own the device. Ranks are otherwise unchanged. Garmin Alpha 200i stays where it is because its handheld-plus-collar system is genuinely superior in backcountry terrain where cellular fails, and that audience knows who they are.

highlights.title: Tractive's adventure model is coming for big dogs
highlights.body: An extra-strong version aimed at large dogs is due this summer, joining the existing XL. New hardware from the category leader is a good sign, and it addresses the one complaint I hear most from owners of 40kg dogs who chew through collar attachments.

highlights.title: Two to three second live updates decide recoveries
highlights.body: In LIVE mode Tractive refreshes position every two to three seconds. When a dog is moving at running speed, that is the difference between a dot you can chase and a dot that is already stale by the time you reach it.

highlights.title: Fi Series 3+ turns charging into a quarterly chore
highlights.body: Intelligent switching between WiFi and cellular gets the Series 3+ to around three months of standby. For a suburban dog that spends most of the day inside a known WiFi zone, this is the most practical battery story in the category.

highlights.title: Cube GPS Pro earns a value bump
highlights.body: I raised its value score to 8.7. Low subscription cost combined with long runtime makes the three-year cost of ownership look excellent, and that is the number people forget to check when they compare sticker prices.

highlights.title: Garmin Alpha 200i remains the off-grid answer
highlights.body: Its handheld and collar pair over a direct radio link rather than a cellular network, so it keeps working in canyons and forest where every LTE tracker goes silent. Hunters and backcountry handlers should still start here.

zh-tw.commentary:
Tractive Dog 6 這週還是穩坐我心中的第一名，而且我對它更有信心了。Tractive 今年夏天要推出針對大型犬的加強版冒險款，加上原本就有的 XL 版本，看得出來這家公司還在認真投資硬體。

我推薦它的核心理由沒變：開啟 LIVE 模式後，定位每兩到三秒更新一次。這個數字聽起來很技術，但實際遇到狗跑掉的時候，它決定你是能追到下一個路口把狗攔下來，還是只能看著一個早就過期的點發呆。另外它一份訂閱涵蓋 175 個國家，這個價位帶真的找不到第二家。

Fi Series 3 維持第二，理由很單純，就是電池。飼主的實際回報普遍是好幾週才充一次電，Series 3+ 靠 WiFi 跟行動網路智慧切換，待機甚至能撐到大概三個月。講白一點，你充它的頻率跟換煙霧偵測器電池差不多。它的項圈是一體式設計，追蹤器沒辦法從帶子上脫落，這點其實蠻關鍵的，因為真的出事的那一刻，追蹤器還在狗身上才有意義。

這週我把 Cube GPS Pro 的性價比分數往上調了 0.1。它主打的就是訂閱費最低加上續航夠長，這個組合養越久越划算。其他名次維持不動。Garmin Alpha 200i 待在原位，因為它的手持機加項圈系統在山區、溪谷這種完全沒訊號的地方依然能用，會需要它的人自己心裡有數。

highlights.title: Tractive 大型犬冒險款夏天登場
highlights.body: 針對大型犬的加強版今年夏天推出，跟現有的 XL 版並存。龍頭品牌願意繼續投資新硬體是好事，而且這正好解決我最常聽到的抱怨，養四十公斤大狗的飼主老是把項圈扣具磨壞。

highlights.title: 兩到三秒更新決定找不找得回來
highlights.body: Tractive 的 LIVE 模式每兩到三秒更新一次位置。狗用跑的移動時，這個頻率就是「你追得到的光點」跟「你跑到現場它早就不在那」的差別。

highlights.title: Fi Series 3+ 讓充電變成一季一次的事
highlights.body: WiFi 與行動網路智慧切換讓 Series 3+ 待機接近三個月。如果你的狗大部分時間待在家裡熟悉的 WiFi 範圍內，這是整個類別裡最實用的續航表現。

highlights.title: Cube GPS Pro 性價比加分
highlights.body: 我把它的性價比拉到 8.7。訂閱費低加上續航長，換算成三年總持有成本非常漂亮，而這正是大家比價時最容易忽略的一筆帳。

highlights.title: Garmin Alpha 200i 依然是沒訊號時的解答
highlights.body: 它靠手持機與項圈直接無線通訊，不吃行動網路，所以在山谷、林道這些 LTE 追蹤器全部啞掉的地方照樣運作。獵犬訓練師跟常帶狗跑野外的人，還是從這台開始看。

en.commentary: The Tractive GPS DOG 6 holds my top spot because it nails the one job that matters most: fast, accurate live tracking with unlimited range on a cellular network, so if your dog bolts, you see exactly where it goes in real time. Add genuinely useful health and activity monitoring and a comfortable, light collar attachment, and it is the tracker I trust with a runner, which is why it leads. The Fi Series 3+ at number two is my pick for battery life and a rugged, escape-artist-proof design, with weeks between charges. The Whistle Cube GPS PRO earns its place with strong health analytics. The SpotOn GPS Fence is the specialist choice for building precise virtual fences without buried wire. The Garmin Alpha 200i rounds out the top five as the serious sporting-dog and off-grid tracker. My guidance: for everyday pet safety and live tracking, buy the Tractive DOG 6, and if you hate charging or own an escape artist, the Fi Series 3+ is the low-maintenance choice.

highlights.title: The Tractive DOG 6 wins on live tracking
highlights.body: Fast, accurate real-time location with unlimited cellular range means you see a bolting dog immediately, which is why it stays my top pick for everyday pet safety.

highlights.title: The Fi Series 3+ wins on battery life
highlights.body: Weeks between charges and a rugged, escape-proof design make it the low-maintenance choice I recommend to owners who hate frequent charging or own a Houdini.

highlights.title: Match the tracker to your risk
highlights.body: Everyday pets want live tracking while off-grid sporting dogs need Garmin's satellite reach, so I steer buyers by where and how their dog actually roams.

zh-tw.commentary: Tractive GPS DOG 6 守住我的第一名，因為它把最重要的一件事做到位：快速、準確的即時追蹤，透過行動網路無限範圍，所以你的狗一暴衝，你能即時看到牠往哪跑。再加上真的實用的健康跟活動監測、輕巧舒適的項圈配件，牠就是我敢託付給一隻愛跑的狗的追蹤器，這就是它領先的原因。排第二的 Fi Series 3+ 是我推給重視續航、又要防脫逃高手的堅固設計，充一次電能撐好幾週。Whistle Cube GPS PRO 靠強大的健康分析站上位置。SpotOn GPS Fence 是不用埋線就能建立精準虛擬圍籬的專門選擇。Garmin Alpha 200i 補齊前五，是認真的獵犬跟離網追蹤器。我的建議：要日常寵物安全跟即時追蹤買 Tractive DOG 6，討厭充電或養了脫逃高手的話，Fi Series 3+ 是低維護的選擇。

highlights.title: Tractive DOG 6 贏在即時追蹤
highlights.body: 快速準確的即時定位加無限行動範圍，讓你在狗暴衝的當下就看到牠，這就是它在日常寵物安全上仍是首選的原因。

highlights.title: Fi Series 3+ 贏在續航
highlights.body: 充一次撐好幾週加堅固防脫逃設計，是我推薦給討厭常充電或養了脫逃高手的飼主的低維護選擇。

highlights.title: 按風險挑追蹤器
highlights.body: 日常寵物要即時追蹤，離網獵犬需要 Garmin 的衛星覆蓋，所以我按你的狗實際在哪、怎麼跑來推薦。

references.title: Fi vs Tractive GPS Dog Tracker (2026)

en.commentary: The Tractive Dog 6 keeps my top spot because it does the one job a tracker exists for better than anything else, live location, with reviewers this week again calling out its consistently accurate updates every two to three seconds and the fastest escape alerts they have tested. A recent app refresh that puts each pet's health and status front and center only strengthens the case. The Fi Series 3 holds second, and it is the pick for owners who value battery life measured in weeks and a proper collar-integrated build with a real leash D-ring. The Cube GPS Pro stays third on long battery and solid value. The SpotOn GPS Fence at four remains the specialist choice for large-property containment, and the Garmin Alpha 200i holds fifth for serious backcountry range, though its subscription and price keep its value score in check. Apple's AirTag is still a Bluetooth finder rather than a true live tracker, so it stays low despite the price. No launches moved the field this week. For most dogs, Tractive is the tracker I would clip on today.

highlights.title: Tractive wins live tracking
highlights.body: Two-to-three second updates and the fastest escape alerts tested keep it the accuracy leader at the top.

highlights.title: Fi for battery and build
highlights.body: Weeks of battery and a real collar-integrated design with a leash D-ring hold it at second.

highlights.title: AirTag is a finder, not a tracker
highlights.body: Bluetooth range means it is not true live tracking, so it stays low despite the friendly price.

zh-tw.commentary: Tractive Dog 6 這週我還是排第一,因為追蹤器存在的核心任務,即時定位,它做得比誰都好。這禮拜的評測又點名它每兩到三秒更新一次、位置一直很準,逃跑警報也是測過最快的。最近 App 改版把每隻毛孩的健康跟狀態擺到最前面,更加分。第二名 Fi Series 3,適合看重續航的飼主,它能撐好幾週,而且是整合式項圈設計,有真的可以扣牽繩的 D 環。Cube GPS Pro 守第三,續航長、性價比也穩。SpotOn GPS Fence 排第四,是大坪數電子圍籬的專門解;Garmin Alpha 200i 守第五,山區長距離很猛,不過訂閱費跟售價壓著它的性價比分數。Apple AirTag 本質還是藍牙尋物器而不是真正的即時追蹤,所以就算便宜也排後面。這週沒有新品攪局。一般的狗,今天我會直接夾上 Tractive。

highlights.title: Tractive 即時定位最強
highlights.body: 每兩三秒更新、逃跑警報最快,穩坐準度第一。

highlights.title: Fi 主打續航跟做工
highlights.body: 續航好幾週,整合式項圈還有可扣牽繩的 D 環,守住第二。

highlights.title: AirTag 是尋物器不是追蹤器
highlights.body: 藍牙範圍不算真的即時追蹤,再便宜也只能排後面。

references.title: 5 Best GPS Pet Trackers of 2026 - Reviewed
Fi vs Tractive: Best GPS Dog Collar for Tracking in 2026

en.commentary: Tractive Dog 6 stays my number one, and the April app update only widened the gap. Reviewers keep measuring the fastest live updates in the category, every two to three seconds, and the new health dashboard with scratch monitoring turns the collar into a genuine wellness tool rather than just a finder. For anyone whose dog is an escape artist, that speed is the whole point. Fi Series 3 holds second on the strength of its battery, which runs for days rather than the day or two you get from most rivals, and its integrated collar looks and wears better than the bulkier Tractive puck. Cube GPS Pro keeps third as the low-subscription, long-battery choice for owners who hate monthly fees, and this week's coverage singled it out for exactly that. SpotOn's GPS fence stays fourth for owners who want a virtual boundary instead of a city tracker. Garmin's Alpha 200i remains the tool for hunting and rural range, unmatched on coverage even if the price keeps it mid-pack. Further down, AirTag still earns a spot as the cheap in-neighborhood option, though it was never built for live tracking. The order held all week, so I kept scores where they were and let the standings stand.

highlights.title: Tractive stays first
highlights.body: Fastest live updates in testing plus a new health and scratch-monitoring dashboard from the April app upgrade.

highlights.title: Fi wins on battery and fit
highlights.body: Days of runtime and a sleeker integrated collar keep the Series 3 at number two.

highlights.title: Cube is the no-subscription pick
highlights.body: Long battery and low ongoing cost make it the choice for owners who hate monthly fees.

highlights.title: Garmin owns rural range
highlights.body: The Alpha 200i stays unmatched on coverage for hunting and open-country tracking.

zh-tw.commentary: Tractive Dog 6 這週還是我的第一，四月那次 App 更新只是把差距拉得更開。評測一直量到它是全類別最快的即時更新，每兩到三秒一次，加上新的健康儀表板跟抓癢監測，讓這個項圈從單純的尋狗器變成真正的健康工具。對家裡養了隻逃脫大師的人來說，這個速度就是重點所在。第二名 Fi Series 3 靠電力站穩，一充能撐好幾天，不像多數對手只撐一兩天，而且它的一體成型項圈比 Tractive 那顆比較笨重的圓餅好看也好戴。第三名 Cube GPS Pro 是低月費、長續航的選擇，很適合討厭每月被扣錢的飼主，這週的報導正好就點名它這一點。第四名 SpotOn GPS 電子圍籬守住，適合想要虛擬邊界而不是市區追蹤的人。Garmin Alpha 200i 還是打獵跟鄉間長距離的工具，覆蓋範圍無人能比，只是價格讓它卡在中段。再往下，AirTag 靠社區內的便宜定位還是有一席之地，只是它本來就不是為即時追蹤設計的。整週排名都很穩，我維持分數，讓名次照舊。

highlights.title: Tractive 續坐第一
highlights.body: 實測即時更新最快，四月 App 升級還加了健康與抓癢監測儀表板。

highlights.title: Fi 贏在電力與配戴
highlights.body: 續航好幾天加上更俐落的一體項圈，讓 Series 3 守住第二。

highlights.title: Cube 是免月費首選
highlights.body: 長續航加低持有成本，最適合討厭每月扣款的飼主。

highlights.title: Garmin 稱霸鄉間距離
highlights.body: Alpha 200i 的覆蓋範圍在打獵跟空曠地追蹤上無人能敵。
